headline: Over $1 Billion in Bullish Crypto Bets Liquidated Amid Spot Market ETF Flows
summary: More than $1 billion in bullish crypto positions were liquidated, while exchange-traded fund flows showed no support in the spot market.
why: Large liquidations in crypto derivatives reflect sudden market deleveraging and volatility, which can cascade across digital asset platforms and spot markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Massive liquidation of bullish bets indicates forced selling pressure in the cryptocurrency market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A rapid unwinding of leveraged long positions triggers forced liquidations, pushing prices lower when spot market demand from ETFs fails to absorb the sell-off.
